summary: Frontend updates largely implement multi-account bank transfer support (React Query hooks, admin UI add/edit/remove + validation, customer dialog selection and copy behavior, WhatsApp confirmation message includes selected bank name with unchanged number). Backend changes shown include adding a migration module, but the diff excerpt for backend/main.mo does not provide evidence of the required new bank-accounts query/save methods, authorization, conditional migration behavior, or default preconfigured accounts.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend bank transfer storage supports multiple bank accounts with authenticated-user read access and admin-only write access; exposes query to return list and admin-only save/update method; preserves existing authorization behavior; single-actor architecture.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend diff excerpt shows imports and an added migration integration, but does not show any getBankAccounts/saveBankAccounts methods, multi-account storage variables, or the associated admin/user authorization checks.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (calls actor.getBankAccounts() and actor.saveBankAccounts(), but backend implementations not shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Conditional state migration on upgrade: migrate old single bankDetails into new list only if present and do not overwrite an already-populated multi-account list.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/migration.mo only converts old.bankDetails to an array; it does not show any conditional logic to avoid overwriting an already-populated new bankAccounts list, nor is the upgrade integration logic visible in the truncated backend/main.mo.

missing_requirements.requirement: Preconfigure backend with exactly three specified default bank accounts when none configured, without overwriting admin-configured accounts.
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the diff summary shows the three default accounts being defined/returned when empty, or any logic guarding against overwriting existing admin-saved accounts.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin UI prevents removing the last remaining bank account entry (requires at least one account).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-26 requires add/edit/remove and validation, but does not specify a minimum of one account; the diff adds an extra restriction and error message for removing the final entry.
